subject: Work sample guidelines, timeline, and reviewer grid
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@example.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, ashley@talenthire.co
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Work sample guidelines, timeline, and reviewer grid

Hi Asha —

Thanks again for taking the process forward with us. As discussed, we9d like to send a short, focused work sample so we can see how you approach product constraints and integration priorities. Below are the deliverable expectations and the timeline.

What we9d like you to do
- Implement a small integration prototype (frontend + mock backend) that demonstrates: handling streaming tokens, graceful degradation on network errors, and a minimal UX for model selection.
- Deliverables: README with run instructions, 4-6 minute screencast walkthrough (optional), and a zipped project with source.
- Time budget: ~6 hours expected. We realize schedules vary; give us an estimate of how long you think it will take.

Deadline
- Please submit by EOD (PST) Friday, July 2, 2027 if possible. If you need a short extension, let us know — we can extend to Monday July 5 for up to one business-day delays.

Evaluation and reviewer process
- We9ll coordinate two primary reviewers from the engineering interview panel and one async reviewer from product. Review window: July 5977 (we9ll aim to have feedback back within 72 hours of submission).
- Rubric links: https://docs.redwood.com/interviewers/review-rubric-v2

Attachments
- Attached: work_sample_instructions.pdf (contains the prompt, minimal dataset, and evaluation checklist).

Next steps
- Reply to this thread with your availability and whether you prefer the Friday or Monday deadline. If you run into any blocker, email me directly.

Appreciate your time — excited to see what you build.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Staff Engineer, Hiring Panel
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: work_sample_instructions.pdf (PDF)]

From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@example.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: ashley@talenthire.co
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Work sample guidelines, timeline, and reviewer grid

Thanks, Vivek —

Appreciate the clear brief and the prompt doc. Friday EOD PST is tight but doable; I9m going to estimate ~7 hours including the screencast. I9d prefer to submit Friday and can confirm by noon PST tomorrow if anything changes. Quick question: is it OK to use a small third-party component for the UI (MIT license) or would you prefer everything to be from-scratch?

Also, can you confirm whether reviewer feedback will include code comments in a shared doc or a short summary?

Thanks,
Asha
asha.patel@example.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Work sample guidelines, timeline, and reviewer grid

Vivek / Aditya 94 looping you both to lock reviewer coverage and windows. Asha is planning for a Friday EOD submission (PST). We should plan reviewer read time on Mon/Tue next week.

Proposed reviewer grid (please confirm):
- Primary reviewer: Aditya Rao (code + architecture) 
- Secondary reviewer: Vivek Kulkarni (integration + UX)
- Async reviewer: Laura Bennett (product rubric / signals)

Reviewer availability
- Aditya: morning blocks Mon 99612 PT, Tue 99611 PT
- Vivek: Mon afternoon 1965 PT, Tue 2967 PT
- Laura: flexible all weekday mornings PT, but prefer Monday if possible

Process notes
- When Asha submits, ask for a single zip + link to the running demo (if included). Reviewers will add comments directly to the shared reviewer doc (link below) and summarize with a go/no-go + notes.
- Please keep review comments short (bullet list) and tag "#hiring" so the recruiter thread picks them up.

Drive + reviewer doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/redwood-work-sample-guidelines

Can you both confirm the grid and whether you want me to schedule a 30-min calibration sync Monday morning if anything looks close / needs alignment?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Recruiting Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@example.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Jul 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Work sample guidelines, timeline, and reviewer grid

Hi all 94 submitting my work sample here. I hit the Friday target and attached the project zip plus a short README and a link to a hosted demo on Netlify. Let me know if you need anything else.

Attachments:
- asha_submission.zip (source + README)

Hosted demo: https://asha-demo.netlify.app (demo is mocked and runs locally in the project)

Notes:
- I used an MIT-licensed UI component (listed in README) for the dropdown and timeline component; implementation decisions are called out in the README under "tradeoffs".
- I9d estimate ~6.5 hours total including the screencast (screencast link included in README).

Thanks for the review — happy to jump on a short call if you want to walk through anything.

Best,
Asha Patel
asha.patel@example.com
